# Spiritual & wellness journey

Combine world-class healthcare with the spiritual fulfilment of visiting the holy sites.

## Healing for body, mind and spirit

At KFSH&RC, we recognise that wellbeing is more than medical care. We support your physical, emotional and spiritual needs throughout your journey.

[Start your journey](link_37)

![Image 11: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/spiritual--wellness-journey/z-pattern/healing---desktop.png)

![Image 12](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/spiritual--wellness-journey/featured-banner/prophet-mosque---desktop.png)![Image 13](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/spiritual--wellness-journey/featured-banner/prophet-mosque---mobile.png)

## Close to the Prophet’s mosque

Our Madinah location is minutes away from Masjid an-Nabawi, offering convenient access for prayer and pilgrimage during treatment.

[View on map](link_42)

### Support for your spiritual practices

We ensure your spiritual needs are respected and supported throughout your stay.

### Prayer rooms

We provide dedicated facilities, offering quiet, comfortable spaces for patients, families, and visitors.

### Halal meals

We offer patients and their families nutritious, culturally appropriate dining options according to halal standards.

### Fasting support

Our healthcare team is able to adjust treatment schedules, medication timings, and meal plans according to your needs.

### Trained staff

Our diverse, multicultural team respects various religious and cultural practices, providing compassionate, culturally sensitive care.

### Official pilgrimage information

Find everything you need to know when embarking on travel for pilgrimage purposes.

*    Hajj and Umrah  
*    Umrah calendar  
*    Makkah and Madinah  
*    Nusuk  
*    Ministry of Hajj and Umrah  
*    e-Services  

## Hajj and Umrah

International patients interested in performing Hajj or Umrah while in Saudi Arabia can find official guidance, requirements, and application procedures through the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah at their official website or dedicated mobile applications.

## Umrah calendar

Umrah can be performed year-round except during the Hajj period, with peak seasons during Ramadan and school holidays when advance planning and early visa applications are recommended for international visitors.

## Makkah and Madinah

Our Jeddah hospital is conveniently located approximately 80 kilometers from Makkah, while our Madinah hospital serves patients in close proximity to the Prophet's Mosque, enabling access to world-class healthcare near Islam's holiest sites.

## [Nusuk Nusuk is the official digital platform by the Ministry of Hajj and Umrah where visitors can apply for pilgrimage permits, book accommodation and transportation, access health services, and manage all aspects of their Hajj or Umrah journey. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/spiritual-and-wellness-journey)

## [Ministry of Hajj and Umrah This is the official government authority responsible for organizing and facilitating pilgrimage services, providing comprehensive information on visa requirements, regulations, authorized service providers, and health guidelines. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/spiritual-and-wellness-journey)

## [e-Services The Ministry of Hajj and Umrah's e-Services portal offers convenient online access to apply for Umrah permits, track application status, manage bookings, and access essential pilgrimage information without visiting physical offices. #### Explore more](link_43)

## Speak to our care team

Get personlised guidance for combining your medical care with your spiritual plans. We're here to make your journey smooth and meaningful.

[Contact International Services](link_44)

![Image 14: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/spiritual--wellness-journey/z-pattern/care-team---desktop.png)

# Plan your journey

Everything you need to plan your treatment journey with confidence. Your complete guide to preparing, travelling, and receiving care at KFSH&RC.

### Your care journey, step by step

Travelling for treatment can feel overwhelming. We’ve broken the process into clear stages so you know exactly what to expect – from your first online consultation to follow-up care once you are back home.

*    Initial assessment  
*    Booking and preparation  
*    Travel & arrival  
*    Treatment & stay  
*    Recovery & discharge  
*    After you return home  

## Initial assessment

Your journey with KFSH&RC begins with initial communication and assessment of your preliminary medical diagnosis through our International Patient Care Centre, which evaluates your medical reports to determine the most appropriate treatment pathway and specialist consultation for your specific condition.

## Booking and preparation

Once your case is accepted, our International Patient Care Centre manages all aspects of your arrival including appointment scheduling, arranging travel logistics, organizing accommodation, and providing guidance on required documentation, so your treatment is as easy as possible.

## Travel & arrival

Upon your arrival, our International Patient Care Centre provides comprehensive reception services including airport assistance, transportation to your accommodation, and orientation support to help you settle comfortably before beginning your treatment at KFSH&RC.

## Treatment & stay

Throughout your treatment at KFSH&RC, you will receive personalized, world-class medical care from internationally renowned specialists - including the physician who conducted your initial consultation - using state-of-the-art technology.

## Recovery & discharge

KFSH&RC provides comprehensive post-treatment evaluation and follow-up consultation services, ensuring you receive detailed discharge instructions, access to your medical reports, and a clear care plan for your continued recovery, whether at home or through our remote monitoring services.

## After you return home

After returning home, you can continue your care journey with KFSH&RC through remote follow-up consultations, access your medical reports and test results via the AlTakhassusi App, and maintain direct communication with your care team to monitor your recovery progress from anywhere in the world.

## Essentials for your trip

 Your complete guide to preparing, travelling, and receiving care at KFSH&RC. 

![Image 4: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/plan-your-visit-page/plan-your-journey/visa---desktop.png)

### Visas

Travel requirements made simple and hassle free.

## Visas

Travel requirements made simple and hassle free.

For your convenience

Dedicated international patient coordinators to answer questions. Assistance with uploading documents and checking application status. Guidance for family members travelling with you.

Medical visa support

We provide an official Medical Referral Letter to support your visa application. Required documents typically include your passport, medical reports and appointment confirmation. Visa types vary by country; our team will guide you on the correct category.

Processing time

Standard processing ranges from 3 to 10 working days, depending on your nationality. We recommend beginning your application as soon as your treatment dates are confirmed.

![Image 5](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/plan-your-visit-page/plan-your-journey/visa---desktop.png)

![Image 6: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/flights---desktop.png)

### Flights

Find guidance on the nearest airports and helpful travel tip...

## Flights

Find guidance on the nearest airports and helpful travel tips.

Arriving in Saudi Arabia

*   Most international patients arrive through Riyadh (RUH), Jeddah (JED), or Madinah (MED) airports.
*   We’ll advise you which airport is closest to your treatment centre.

Before you book

*   Confirm your treatment dates and estimated stay before purchasing tickets.
*   Flexible or refundable tickets are recommended for medical travel.

Facilities to look for

*   Meet-and-greet assistance for international patients.
*   Fast-track support for elderly or mobility-restricted travellers.
*   Direct transfer to the hospital or your accommodation.

  

**Tip for travelers:** Choose flights arriving at least a day before admission to allow rest and adjustment.

![Image 7](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/flights---desktop.png)

![Image 8: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/plan-your-visit-page/plan-your-journey/stay---desktop.png)

### Accommodation

Comfortable options for every budget.

## Accommodation

Comfortable options for every budget.

Accommodation options

*   Hotels within 5–15 minutes of the hospital
*   Serviced apartments for longer stays
*   Recovery-friendly hotel partners recommended by our care team

What we can help you with

*   Advice on neighbourhoods close to the hospital
*   Letters for discounted medical-travel rates (where applicable)
*   Assistance for family stay arrangements 

Facilities to look for

*   Wheelchair access and lift availability
*   Meal options suited to medical patients
*   Quiet rooms for recovery
*   Easy transport to hospital

  

**Tip for travelers:**Book accommodation early during peak seasons (Ramadan, Hajj, school holidays).

![Image 9](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/plan-your-visit-page/plan-your-journey/stay---desktop.png)

### Understanding costs

Complete transparency at every step; because we believe healthcare decisions should never be complicated by unclear costs.

### Estimates

You’ll receive a detailed breakdown covering procedures, tests, hospital stay and expected duration.

### Payments

We accept bank transfers, major credit cards and approved insurance coverage.

### Insurance

Our team reviews your documents to confirm what is included and what may need self-payment.

### Financial clarity

We share your estimated timeline, approved costs and any optional add-ons before treatment begins.

![Image 10](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/plan-your-visit-page/featured-banner/staying-connected---desktop.png)![Image 11](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/plan-your-visit-page/featured-banner/staying-connected---mobile.png)

## Staying connected

Your international patient coordinator will guide you through estimated costs, confirmation of coverage, and payment timelines. We ensure you have complete clarity before you begin your treatment journey.

## **Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Hospital**

## National Guard Health Affairs - Madinah

## General Information

**PMBAH is the fifth Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs (MNGHA) facility in the Kingdom after Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and Al Ahsa. It is a fully serviced facility with a 215-bed capacity. The Hospital will provide primary and secondary care to National Guard personnel.**

**The MNGHA gives high regard to the welfare of its workforce. For example, orientation and induction are given to new staff to ensure they are competent, confident, and supported through mentorship and preceptorship to mold them into the workforce. Furthermore, benefits and rewards are very encouraging to the staff.**

## Hospital Location

 Madinah is the second holy city to Muslims after Makkah. It has also got many other names such as Taibah, Yathrib, the City of the Messenger, and Dar Al-Higra (i.e. Home of Immigration). It is the city whose people supported Prophet Mohammad (peace be upon him) when he immigrated from Makkah. It comprises the Mosque of the Prophet, his grave, the Islamic University, King Fahd Complex for the Printing of the Holy Quran and many archaeological Islamic features. Madinah is a city in the Hejaz region of western Saudi Arabia, and serves as the capital of the Al Madinah Province.   
  
 Located at the foot of Mount Uhud on Prince Naif Road. PMBAH is only minutes away from Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Airport and the Holy Mosque – Al Masjid Al Nabawi. 

## Departments & Services

*   Rumailah Hospital (644 bed)
*   Hamad General Hospital (603 bed)
*   Women’s Hospital (319 bed)
*   National Center for Cancer Care and Research (NCCCR) (86 bed)
*   Heart Hospital (116 bed)
*   Al Wakra Hospital (325 bed)
*   Al Khor Hospital (115 bed)
*   Fahad bin Jassim Kidney Center
*   Hazm Mebaireek General Hospital (HMGH) (men’s clinic)

![Image 7](https://ihrcanada.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/8b7f20d3-b1b8-4016-b36c-5b7c24fd573e-1024x611.jpeg)

## Employment Information

**Thinking about working at this hospital? For employment details, check out each topic information below**

[Message to All Candidates](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

All SANG Hospital facilities are JCIA accredited

[Working Hours](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   The standard work week at National Guard is 42.5 hours per week.
*   5 Days per week / The number of hours in a shift vary somewhat from department to department but generally do not exceed 10 hours
*   The standard work week in Saudi Arabia is Sunday through Thursday

[Uniforms](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Uniforms are provided on arrival.
*   Uniforms consist of white trousers and tunic top for females, and white trousers and a jacket for males.
*   Duty shoes are not provided and should be purchased by the employee. 

[Housing](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Free housing accommodation is provided
*   Medical City: The City covers approximately one square mile set against a background of low desert hills. This first-class accommodation is in apartment blocks of one, two or three bedrooms and is within easy walking distance of the hospital.
*   All hard and soft furnishings are provided free of charge including washing machine, tumble drier, fridge/freezer and all kitchen utensils.
*   Al Aoun Village is comprised of three bedroom detached and attached villas where mainly accompanied status housing and single male housing is located.
*   In addition to the villas there are three- and one-bedroom bungalows. You will have complete comfort and privacy like your own home
*   All units are fully furnished for the employees’ convenience
*   Utilities such as electricity, water and gas cooking are free and paid-provided by NG for all employees. Cable TV is also provided. Taxi / Limousine services are provided at fixed rates.

[Recreational Facilities](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Employee accommodations are adjacent to the hospital and are equipped with excellent recreational facilities, including an Olympic-sized swimming pool, tennis courts, gymnasium, and weight rooms.The compound is fully secured with 24 hours security by the military personnel*
*   Restaurants, Cafes, supermarkets, shopping malls libraries, hairdressing salons & services are all readily accessible*
*   There are a wide range of restaurants in the cities; serving traditional Lebanese, Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, etc (including popular Western fare eg McDonalds and Starbucks)*
*   Organized camping trips to local scenic areas and places of interest take place at regular intervals and it is possible to join others from the hospital on short trips to neighbouring countries such as Egypt, Yemen and Jordan*
*   For children of eligible staff there is child care for pre-school infants as well as a primary school providing a British based education system*
*   There are a wide range of activities available for the athletic, adventurous or nature lover
*   Jeddah probably enjoys the best shopping facilities in The Kingdom. There are numerous well stocked, western style, supermarkets, ultra modern, air conditioned shopping malls and dozens of traditional local markets with an atmosphere all their own. Good buys include gold, watches, carpets and electrical goods
*   Al Aoun Village offers 24 hours security to maintain peaceful and secure surroundings. The facilities offer exemplary services, spacious gardens and beautiful landscaping, swimming pools, modern fitness and recreation center, gymnasium, satellite TV, and a spacious parking area

*Facilities vary per hospital

[Benefits](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Employment contracts are for either one or two years, at the employee’s option, and are very often renewable.
*   Tax Free Income
*   Able to Save the Majority of Your Salary
*   Yearly Service Award (Re-contracting Bonus)
*   Provision of Furnished Housing
*   Yearly Round Trip ticket to Point of Hire
*   Free Medical Coverage
*   Opportunity to Travel (Europe, Fareast and Africa)
*   Single contract /Married contract
*   Some of the positions with a Family Contract (Accompanied Status) up to 3 eligible dependents, one of whom is a spouse
*   Education Allowances for Married contract (2 eligible dependents only, 6-18 years of age)SR23,000 each eligible dependent per school year, subject to submission of school invoices
*   Annual round-trip ticket to Riyadh directly from the location of the school outside the Kingdom Of Saudi Arabia
*   Housing Accommodation
*   Transportation Services
*   Free mobilization and de-mobilization flights to and from point of origin.
*   Baggage allowance
*   30 days of Annual Leave per year ( 2.5 days per month of service, to be utilized by the employee after 6 months of service)
*   Holiday Leave per year ( 5 Days Eid Al Fitr, 5 Days Hajj and 1 Day Saudi National Day)
*   Mid year Benefit (Ticket and 10 days post leave)
*   Entitle for the Overtime Pay (Rate per hour * 150%)
*

## **Saudi Arabia**

**Saudi Arabia, officially the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, is a country in Western Asia. It spans the vast majority of the Arabian Peninsula, with a land area of approximately 2,150,000 km². Saudi Arabia is the largest country in the Middle East, and the second-largest country in the Arab world.**

## **Healthcare System**

**The healthcare industry in Saudi Arabia is growing rapidly and will continue to provide excellent and challenging opportunities for providers. The Ministry of Health is the major client with 63% of hospital beds, followed by the private sector with 13%, the Ministry of Defense and Aviation with 8%, the Ministry of Higher Education with 7%, the National Guard with 3%, and the General Organization for Social Insurance, the Royal Commission and the Ministry of Interior with 2% each.**

**The government of Saudi Arabia continues to provide massive support to existing as well as new projects in order to see that health services are accessible to all people at all levels of care – primary, secondary, and tertiary.  
Some of these hospitals are world famous for referrals, teaching and research, e.g., King Khalid Eye Specialist Hospital, King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Center, Ministry of Defense and Aviation Hospitals, National Guard Hospitals, and Security Forces Hospitals.**

# International patients

KFSH&RC welcomes patients from around the world seeking world-class medical expertise and compassionate care.

### Why choose KFSH&RC?

Where advanced medicine meets compassionate support for patients from around the world.

### Expert specialists

Internationally recognised doctors delivering advanced, specialised care.

### Hi-tech

Cutting-edge equipment and precision treatments for complex conditions.

### Supportive care

Help with visas, travel, appointments, and cultural needs at every step.

### Trusted outcomes

Strong success rates and global rankings trusted by patients worldwide.

## Let us guide your path to world-class care

Whether you are planning your first visit or returning for follow-up care, we help you navigate the process with clarity and comfort.

[Start your journey](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/plan-your-journey)[Contact International Services](link_38)

![Image 4: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/z-patterns/word-class-care---desktop.png)

![Image 5](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/featured-banner/innovation---desktop.png)![Image 6](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/featured-banner/innovation---mobile.png)

## Innovation that shapes the future of healthcare

As a hospital mandated to advance medical innovation in Saudi Arabia, we gain early access to breakthrough technologies and next-generation treatments. Patients come to us for care they simply cannot find anywhere else in the region.

[Latest medical breakthroughs](link_7)

## Specialized care built around you

Browse our world-class facilities, from Centres of Excellence to ground-breaking specialty departments.

[Explore our Centres & specialties](link_11)

![Image 7: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/z-patterns/specialized-care---desktop.png)

![Image 8](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/featured-banner/visit-essentials---desktop.png)![Image 9](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/featured-banner/visit-essentials---mobile.png)

## Your visit essentials

We’re here to support our international patients on every stage of their journey. We have dedicated patient coordination services available to assist with travel arrangements, visa requirements, ground transportation and a lot more.

[Plan your journey](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/plan-your-journey)

## Wellness & spiritual journey

A healing experience that cares for body, mind, and spirit.  
 Whether you want to incorporate wellness into your recovery, or plan your visit around Umrah or Hajj, our team supports both your medical and spiritual needs.

[Learn more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/spiritual-and-wellness-journey)

![Image 10: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/z-patterns/wellness--spiritual-journey--desktop.png)

## Care that includes your family

At KFSH&RC, your loved ones are part of your care journey. Family visits are actively welcomed throughout your stay, and for longer recoveries, our dedicated recovery hotel ensures the people you love remain close and comfortable.  
  
We also offer family accommodation support, so you can focus fully on healing while staying connected to the people who matter most. Your recovery experience is enriched when your loved ones are by your side.

![Image 11: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/z-patterns/family---desktop.png)

## Explore Saudi Arabia

 Experience everything that this world-renowned region is famous for. 

![Image 12: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/block-cards---explore-saudi/destination---desktop.png)

### Destinations

Explore iconic sites, landmarks, and natural wonders.

### Things to do

Experience dining, shopping, wellness, and culture.

_[https://www.visitsaudi.com/en/things-to-do](link_40)_

![Image 14: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/international-patients-landing-page/block-cards---explore-saudi/saudi-map---desktop.png)

### Saudi map

View major cities, hospitals, and travel routes at a glance.

_[https://map.visitsaudi.com/en?\_ga=2.211888279.2069175242.1769770360-888150280.1769770360&\_gl=1*wdfd2q*\_gcl\_au*MTU1OTg1Mjg2Ni4xNzY5NzcwMzYx](link_41)_

Frequently asked questions

### Do I need a referral?

Referral requirements depend on your case and insurance coverage. International patients are encouraged to submit their medical reports for initial assessment, while some services may require a referral from your primary healthcare provider to facilitate treatment planning.

### What medical documents should I send?

Submit recent medical reports, diagnostic test results, imaging studies (X-rays, CT scans, MRIs), pathology reports, current medication list, treatment history, and referral letters from your physician to enable our medical team to assess your case and develop an appropriate treatment plan.

# King Faisal Specialist Hospital and Research Centre in Saudi Arabia

Located in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Madinah, King Faisal Specialist Hospital ranks among the best hospitals in Saudi Arabia for international patients and complex treatments

 Book an Appointment 

![Image 7](link_10)

![Image 8](link_11) Ranked No. 1 Best Hospital in Saudi Arabia for 5 consecutive years; best in the Middle East for oncology and orthopaedics (Newsweek 2026) 

## We're at your service

our story

Ranked among the World's Best Hospitals in 2026 and No. 1 in Saudi Arabia for 5 consecutive years (Newsweek), KFSH&RC in Riyadh, Jeddah, and Madinah has treated international patients from 17 countries.  
  
KFSH&RC delivers internationally accredited care across organ transplantation, oncology, and cardiac surgery using the same robotic platforms, surgical protocols, and outcome benchmarks as the world's leading academic medical centres.  
  
Its programmes include the Arab world's only lung transplant centre, the Gulf's only heart transplant programme, locally manufactured CAR-T cell therapy, and 5,000+ kidney transplants since 1981 supported by the world's largest Kidney Paired Donation Programme.  
  
From the world's first fully robotic heart transplant in 2024 to a top-10 globally ranked epilepsy surgery programme, KFSH&RC performs procedures that exist nowhere else in the Arab world, making it the primary destination for GCC patients with conditions their local systems cannot manage.  
  
Your scans are reviewed before you travel, your international patient coordinator is assigned from the first enquiry, and your follow-up continues through the AlTakhassusi App after you return home.

[Read more](link_2)

From visa support to airport pickups and accommodation, we handle every detail of your medical trip

Family-Centred Care at its Best

For 35 years, Saudi German Hospital (SGH) in Saudi Arabia has been the leading hospital in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region. This legacy of care and expertise is evident, with 5 of its hospitals recognised among the best in 2024 by Newsweek magazine.

 With specialties ranging from bariatrics, transplants to cardiology, SGH provides excellent results. Through a partnership with Mayo Clinic, a global leader in healthcare, the facility integrates the latest medical advancements, including robotic surgeries.

 Accredited by the JCI, SGH upholds high standards of patient safety. Their team includes internationally visiting doctors from the USA and Germany. The facilities are designed for patient comfort and the environment is crafted for your peace of mind and well-being.

# Delivering world-class care with compassion

Advanced medical expertise meets genuine human connection. Our internationally trained specialists combine cutting-edge treatments with personalized care.

[Start a Referral](https://kfshrcsystems.kfshrc.edu.sa/ehalahweb/ehalah/landing.xhtml)[Contact International Services](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/international-services-form)[Find a Doctor](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/find-a-doctor)

## Discover our hospitals

 Our three globally-renowned medical campuses each offer the advanced facilities, specialized care, and state-of-the-art medical technology that make King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre a leader in healthcare excellence. 

![Image 5: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/riyadh---desktop.png)

### Riyadh

Our internationally-accredited flagship 1,500-bed hospital.

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=riyadh)_

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=riyadh)_

## KFSH&RC at Riyadh

As the main hospital and research centre of KFSH&RC, the Riyadh campus delivers advanced medical and surgical care for patients across Saudi Arabia and around the world. It leads programs in organ transplantation, cancer treatment and genomic medicine, supported by world-class research, education and technology, and a growing network for international referrals and follow-up.

Highlights:

*   Over 1,500 inpatient beds and advanced intensive care units.
*   Home to Saudi Arabia’s leading organ transplant and oncology programmes.
*   Houses the Research Centre, pioneering breakthroughs in genetics and biotechnology.
*   Accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI)for quality and patient safety.
*   Performed the world’s first fully robotic heart transplant surgery.

[Explore our specialties](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=Riyadh)

![Image 6](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/modal/riyadh.png)

![Image 7: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/jeddah---desktop.png)

### Jeddah

Leading centre for specialist care, training, and research.

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=jeddah)_

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=jeddah)_

## KFSH&RC at Jeddah

Located on the Red Sea coast, the Jeddah campus extends KFSH&RC’s legacy of excellence to the Western Region, offering integrated care and access to highly specialised services. It combines advanced clinical services and training with a compassionate, patient-centred approach to care.

Highlights:

*   Approximately 470 beds across general and specialised wards.
*   Advanced cardiac care,paediatric surgery, and oncology units.
*   Supported by a strong telemedicine network linked to Riyadh for complex consultations.
*   Known for its active research, education, and academic affiliations.

[Explore our specialties](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=jeddah)

![Image 8](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/modal/jeddah.png)

![Image 9: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/careers/careers-landing-page/block-cards/new-client/spotlight-image-3.png)

### Madinah

State-of-the-art 300-bed hospital in the Holy City.

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=madinah)_

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=madinah)_

## KFSH&RC at Madinah

The newest hospital in our network, combining modern design, digital innovation, and advanced facilities to expand access to specialised care in the Holy City. Its expert teams focus on cancer, ophthalmology, and women’s health.

Highlights:

*   State-of-the-art facility with around 300 beds and smart hospital systems.
*   Focus on critical care, oncology, and outpatient specialties.
*   Integrated with the national health transformation strategy,Vision 2030.
*   Designed to deliver high-quality care in a serene, patient-first setting.
*   Won the 2023 Press Ganey “Human Experience Guardian of Excellence” award for being in the top 5% globally in patient experience for outpatient services.

[Explore our specialties](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=Madinah)

![Image 10](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/careers/careers-landing-page/block-cards/new-client/madinah.png)

### Centres of Excellence

Our Centres of Excellence are dedicated spaces for complex care across our network, bringing together research, education, and clinical expertise to give you consistent, coordinated, and personalized support.

*    Cancer Centre of Excellence  
*    Organ Transplant Centre of Excellence  
*    Heart Centre of Excellence  
*    Genomics Medicine Centre of Excellence  
*    Medical Centre of Excellence  
*    Neuroscience Centre of Excellence

# Delivering world-class care with compassion

Advanced medical expertise meets genuine human connection. Our internationally trained specialists combine cutting-edge treatments with personalized care.

[Start a Referral](https://kfshrcsystems.kfshrc.edu.sa/ehalahweb/ehalah/landing.xhtml)[Contact International Services](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/international-services-form)[Find a Doctor](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/find-a-doctor)

## Discover our hospitals

 Our three globally-renowned medical campuses each offer the advanced facilities, specialized care, and state-of-the-art medical technology that make King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre a leader in healthcare excellence. 

![Image 5: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/riyadh---desktop.png)

### Riyadh

Our internationally-accredited flagship 1,500-bed hospital.

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=riyadh)_

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=riyadh)_

## KFSH&RC at Riyadh

As the main hospital and research centre of KFSH&RC, the Riyadh campus delivers advanced medical and surgical care for patients across Saudi Arabia and around the world. It leads programs in organ transplantation, cancer treatment and genomic medicine, supported by world-class research, education and technology, and a growing network for international referrals and follow-up.

Highlights:

*   Over 1,500 inpatient beds and advanced intensive care units.
*   Home to Saudi Arabia’s leading organ transplant and oncology programmes.
*   Houses the Research Centre, pioneering breakthroughs in genetics and biotechnology.
*   Accredited by Joint Commission International (JCI)for quality and patient safety.
*   Performed the world’s first fully robotic heart transplant surgery.

[Explore our specialties](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=Riyadh)

![Image 6](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/modal/riyadh.png)

![Image 7: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/jeddah---desktop.png)

### Jeddah

Leading centre for specialist care, training, and research.

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=jeddah)_

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=jeddah)_

## KFSH&RC at Jeddah

Located on the Red Sea coast, the Jeddah campus extends KFSH&RC’s legacy of excellence to the Western Region, offering integrated care and access to highly specialised services. It combines advanced clinical services and training with a compassionate, patient-centred approach to care.

Highlights:

*   Approximately 470 beds across general and specialised wards.
*   Advanced cardiac care,paediatric surgery, and oncology units.
*   Supported by a strong telemedicine network linked to Riyadh for complex consultations.
*   Known for its active research, education, and academic affiliations.

[Explore our specialties](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=jeddah)

![Image 8](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/healthcare-homepage/block-cards/modal/jeddah.png)

![Image 9: Card 2](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/careers/careers-landing-page/block-cards/new-client/spotlight-image-3.png)

### Madinah

State-of-the-art 300-bed hospital in the Holy City.

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=madinah)_

_[Explore our specialities](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=madinah)_

## KFSH&RC at Madinah

The newest hospital in our network, combining modern design, digital innovation, and advanced facilities to expand access to specialised care in the Holy City. Its expert teams focus on cancer, ophthalmology, and women’s health.

Highlights:

*   State-of-the-art facility with around 300 beds and smart hospital systems.
*   Focus on critical care, oncology, and outpatient specialties.
*   Integrated with the national health transformation strategy,Vision 2030.
*   Designed to deliver high-quality care in a serene, patient-first setting.
*   Won the 2023 Press Ganey “Human Experience Guardian of Excellence” award for being in the top 5% globally in patient experience for outpatient services.

[Explore our specialties](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties?filter=Madinah)

![Image 10](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/careers/careers-landing-page/block-cards/new-client/madinah.png)

# Centres & Specialties

Browse our world-class facilities, from Centres of Excellence to ground-breaking specialty departments.

### Centres of Excellence

Our Centres of Excellence are dedicated hubs for complex care across our network, bringing together research, education, and clinical expertise to give you consistent, coordinated, and personalized support.

*    Cancer Centre of Excellence  
*    Organ Transplant Centre of Excellence  
*    Heart Centre of Excellence  
*    Genomics Medicine Centre of Excellence  
*    Medical Centre of Excellence  
*    Neuroscience Centre of Excellence  
*    Surgical Centre of Excellence  
*    Pediatrics & Women's Centre of Excellence  

## [Cancer Centre of Excellence 7 specialties As the Gulf's largest premier cancer facility, we treat nearly a quarter of all cancer cases in Saudi Arabia annually, with survival outcomes that match or surpass leading global centres. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/cancer-centre-of-excellence)

## [Organ Transplant Centre of Excellence 12 Specialities We lead the Middle East in life-saving organ transplantation, performing 1,092 organ transplants within a single year, including the world's first fully robotic liver transplant. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/organ-transplant-centre-of-excellence)

## [Heart Centre of Excellence 5 Specialties As the only active heart transplant program in the Kingdom and the Gulf region, and the largest program in the Asia Pacific region, we rank among the top 10% of transplant centres worldwide. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/heart-centre-of-excellence)

## [Genomic Medicine Centre of Excellence 4 Specialties Our specialists use pioneering genomic testing to tailor treatments to your unique genetic profile, transforming how we diagnose and treat inherited conditions. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/genomics-medicine-centre-of-excellence)

## [Medical Centre of Excellence 5 Specialties Bringing eight expert teams together under one roof, our Medical Centre offers you quicker answers and a clear plan across immunology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, infectious diseases, internal medicine, nephrology, pulmonary medicine, and rheumatology. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/medical-centre-of-excellence)

## [Neuroscience Centre of Excellence 8 Specialties Our multidisciplinary teams deliver precise, innovative treatments for conditions like brain tumours, stroke, epilepsy, and movement disorders. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/neuroscience-centre-of-excellence)

## [Surgical Centre of Excellence 6 Specialties Whether a minimally invasive procedure or a complex operation, our specialists provide expert treatment that puts your safety, comfort, and recovery first. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/surgical-centre-of-excellence)

## [Pediatrics & Women's Centre of Excellence 3 Specialties We offer specialised paediatric treatments, comprehensive women's health services, and compassionate support for families, providing outstanding care with dedication. #### Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/pediatrics-and-women-centre)

## Specialties

 Searching for a specific area of expertise? Browse our specialty areas below. 

[View all](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties)

### [Autism Riyadh Madinah](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties/autism-centre)### [Adult Hamatology Jeddah](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties/adult-hematology)### [Adult intensive care Madinah](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/all-specialties/adult-intensive-care)

## Pioneering the future of cardiac care

Home to the world’s first fully robotic heart transplant, our Heart Centre has performed over 400 robotic surgeries with a 98% survival rate

[Explore more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/centres-and-specialties/centres-of-excellence/heart-centre-of-excellence)

# Educating future healthcare leaders

KFSH&RC delivers world-class medical education through over 200 specialized programs, state-of-the-art simulation facilities, and partnerships with leading international institutions.

[Browse programs](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/medical-education)[Contact us](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/contact)

### Educational programs for every stage of your career

From foundational medical training courses to specialized advanced programs, KFSH&RC provides the education that transforms healthcare professionals into leaders.

*    Undergraduate programs  
*    Postgraduate programs  
*    Non-medical training  
*    Professional growth  
*    Scholarships  

## [Undergraduate programs Providing aspiring physicians with a comprehensive foundation in medical science and clinical practice through our partnership with Alfaisal University. Students benefit from world-class faculty, state-of-the-art facilities, and early clinical exposure in one of the region's most advanced academic medical centres. #### Learn more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/undergraduate-medical-education-box)

## [Postgraduate programs KFSH&RC's postgraduate medical education programs support both residency and fellowship training accredited by the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties and the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education International, focusing on research in cancer, cardiovascular diseases, transplant immunology, genetics, molecular diagnostics, and proteomics. #### Learn more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/postgraduate-medical-education)

## [Non-medical training KFSH&RC provides comprehensive non-medical training programs across administrative, technical, and support service departments, offering students hands-on experience in healthcare operations at one of the world's leading academic medical centres. #### Learn more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/undergraduate-non-medical-education)

## [Professional growth At KFSH&RC, professional growth is integral to our culture, offering employees access to internationally accredited training programs, mentorship from world-renowned specialists, opportunities to contribute to groundbreaking research, and clear pathways for career advancement within a top 15 global academic medical centre. #### Learn more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/professional-growth-and-learning)

## [Scholarships KFSH&RC supports the development of future healthcare leaders through scholarship programs that provide financial assistance to qualified students pursuing medical and healthcare education. #### Learn more](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/scholarship)

## Learning portal

 We provide healthcare professionals, researchers, and students with comprehensive online access to medical journals, databases, research publications, and clinical resources. 

[View all](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/knowledge-resources)

### [Health sciences library Access the region's leading resource for healthcare professionals and researchers.](https://lib.kfshrc.edu.sa/?_gl=1*1126bu3*_gcl_au*MjY0MjMyMzkxLjE3NjkwODk5NTg.)### [Life Support Training Explore digital learning for continuous professional development.](https://lstc.kfshrc.edu.sa/?_gl=1*td9u4d*_gcl_au*MjY0MjMyMzkxLjE3NjkwODk5NTg.)### [Scientific publishing Explore published research driving progress in medical science.](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/education/knowledge-resources/publications-office)### [Motamarat events Browse continuing medical education events, all in one accessible app.](https://motamarat.kfshrc.edu.sa/?_gl=1*1cf6vpa*_gcl_au*MjY0MjMyMzkxLjE3NjkwODk5NTg.)

## Featured: Life Support Centre

The region's premier training hub for emergency skills, offering comprehensive courses in Basic Life Support, Advanced Cardiac Life Support, Pediatric Advanced Life Support, and Neonatal Resuscitation Program.

[Learn more](https://lstc.kfshrc.edu.sa/)

![Image 3: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/education-homepage/z-patterns/featured-life-support-centre---desktop.png)

## Spotlight: Dr. Ali Saeed Alzahrani

Over a 30-year career, Dr. Ali Saeed Alzahrani has progressed from an Internal Medicine resident at KFSH&RC to Executive Director of the Research Centre, with opportunities at each stage to develop his expertise and take on new roles.  
  
After fellowship training at Johns Hopkins, he became a Consultant Endocrinologist, established an endocrine research program, and founded the Endocrine Oncology Fellowship. His journey reflects how KFSH&RC enables clinicians to continuously learn, teach, and lead.

![Image 4: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/education-homepage/z-patterns/new/dr-alzahrani---desktop.png)

## Medical breakthroughs through research

KFSH&RC's award-winning research transforms scientific discovery into compassionate care, developing innovative treatments that give our patients access to tomorrow's medicine today.

[Explore research](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/research)

![Image 8: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/education-homepage/z-patterns/new/medical-breakthrough---desktop.png)

## Build your future with healthcare leaders

KFSH&RC offers exceptional career opportunities across medical, research, and support services. Join over 16,000 professionals from 63+ nationalities who are shaping the future of healthcare through innovation, collaboration, and commitment to excellence.

[Join our team](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/careers)

![Image 9: A team of surgeons performing an operation under surgical lights](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/kfh-images--for-content/education-homepage/z-patterns/new/build-your-future---desktop.png)

Frequently asked questions

### When do applications open for the next academic year?

Application periods vary by program type. Medical internship applications open with announced submission windows, with results within two weeks. Postgraduate medical training programs including fellowships and residencies are submitted through the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties website.

### Are KFSH&RC programs accredited internationally?

Yes, many of our medical education programs are internationally recognized and unique to the region. KFSH&RC ranks 15th globally among the world's top 250 academic medical centres, ensuring our clinical training programs and healthcare courses meet rigorous international standards.

### Does KFSH&RC offer part-time or online education programs?

Yes, we provide digital learning through the iLearn Learning Management System for continuing medical education (CME) accessible anytime, anywhere. While core programs require full-time commitment, our healthcare courses include flexible CME options. Contact Academic and Training Affairs for specific formats.

### Does KFSH&RC have any partnerships with educational institutions?

Our institution collaborates with Johns Hopkins Medicine International, Alfaisal University, Mayo Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and MIT. This provides trainees in our medical education programs with exposure to groundbreaking innovations and world-class expertise in clinical training.

### How do I access CME courses through Motamarat?

The Motamarat application showcases continuing medical education activities for KFSH&RC healthcare professionals. Staff access Motamarat through internal systems to view upcoming CME courses, conferences, and medical professional development events.

## **Qatar**

**Qatar is located in Western Asia. Qatar resides on the small peninsula of Qatar in the Arabian Peninsula, which shares a land border with Saudi Arabia, a member of the Gulf Cooperation Council. Its territory is largely surrounded by the Persian Gulf. Qatar is separated from Bahrain by the Gulf of Bahrain, an inlet of the Persian Gulf. The country’s capital is Doha, which is home to over 80% of its population.**

## **Healthcare System**

**Qatar’s healthcare services are recognized both internationally and nationwide for its quality and high standards. The hospitals are equipped with the most technologically advanced medical equipment. The Public Health sector is regulated by the Supreme Council of Health (SCH) to ensure quality and consistency of services provided. There are both private and public healthcare organizations in Qatar providing a wide range of services from family practice and specialist consulting to rehabilitation and nursing.**

## Saudi Arabia Climate

Saudi Arabia is a relatively large country offering vast contrasts of climate, scenery and relief from the temperate, rainy heights of the rugged southwestern mountains to the dry, daunting wastes of the great Rub’ al-Khali desert.

Throughout the country temperatures drop significantly at night. Even day-time temperatures can be rather cool, depending upon the location and the season. Travelers are, therefore advised to take some heavy clothing with them in winter as well as the usual light apparel.

## **United Arab Emirates**

**The United Arab Emirates (UAE) is situated in the Southeast of the Arabian Peninsula, bordering Oman and Saudi Arabia. In December 1971, the UAE became a federation of six emirates – Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al-Quwain, and Fujairah, while the seventh emirate, Ras Al Khaimah, joined the federation in 1972. It has a population of 9.89Million in 2020.**

## **Healthcare System**

**Government-funded health services are available in the UAE, along with a rapidly growing private health sector. There are both federal and Emirates regulations governing healthcare. Healthcare in the UAE varies from one emirate to another, but you can expect top-quality care everywhere. Foreigners have access to both public and private services for a fee. Emirati nationals have access to health care at a low cost and sometimes for free.**

## Saudi Arabia Climate

Saudi Arabia is a relatively large country offering vast contrasts of climate, scenery and relief from the temperate, rainy heights of the rugged southwestern mountains to the dry, daunting wastes of the great Rub’ al-Khali desert.

Throughout the country temperatures drop significantly at night. Even day-time temperatures can be rather cool, depending upon the location and the season. Travelers are, therefore advised to take some heavy clothing with them in winter as well as the usual light apparel.

## **King Faisal Specialist and Research Center**

## Jeddah

## General Information

**King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre (Gen. Org.), Jeddah (KFSH&RC-J) is an internationally recognized tertiary health care organization, with a long tradition of quality patient care. A 500-bed tertiary specialist hospital. Is one of three campuses of the best ranked tertiary acute care facilities (Gen.Org)**

**The facility was originally built as a private hospital in the 1990s until it was purchased by the Saudi government, and began offering public services in March 2000, due to the generous gift of The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, King Fahad Bin Abdul Aziz. It was his wish to provide outstanding medical services to the people of the Western region.**

**This care facility – Jeddah has grown to becoming one of the leading Healthcare Providers in the Middle East. Currently is undergoing a significant expansion, with the construction and commissioning of a new medical city located north of Jeddah, near the airport. The phase one of this new hospital will open in late 2021 or 2022, with over 1,000 beds including 152 ICU beds and 30 operating rooms. The new complex will also include brand new housing for staff.**

**Jeddah has preserved some of the old architecture in the heart of the city, while building wonderful, classic villas and modern high-rise towers. The city is rich in restaurants with cuisine from all cultures and in all price ranges.**

## Hospital Location

This luxurious hospital is in downtown Jeddah, a city of approximately 4 million, situated along the Red Sea, only a few minutes away from the King Abdulaziz International airport.

## Employment Information

[Message to All Candidates](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-faisal-specialist-and-research-center-in-jeddah-saudi-arabia/)

*   Ranked #1 in the Region Tertiary Acute Care Facility, Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

[Working Hours](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-faisal-specialist-and-research-center-in-jeddah-saudi-arabia/)

*   5 days a week / The number of hours in a shift varies somewhat from department to department but generally does not exceed 10 hours
    *   Working hours varies per department (average) 44 hours per week.
    *   Saudi Arabia now enjoys a Sunday to Thursday work week, with Friday and Saturday its official weekend.

[Uniforms](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-faisal-specialist-and-research-center-in-jeddah-saudi-arabia/)

*   Usually, the hospital will provide candidates a white outfit, but they are permitted to wear colorful shirts
*   The trousers should always be white.
*   Candidates need to bring their own shoes for work. They need to be light colored but not necessarily white.

[Housing](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-faisal-specialist-and-research-center-in-jeddah-saudi-arabia/)

*   Suitable furnished accommodation will be provided, or a housing allowance is normally paid
*   Employees who are receiving the housing allowance are paid a local transportation allowance to defray all or a portion of the expenses associated with personal transportation
*   Housing assignments are divided by single women, single men & family
*   Housing for single women is located on site, single men is nearby. For family accommodation located both on and off site nearby
*   Free fully furnished western-standard housing accommodation

[Recreational Facilities](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-faisal-specialist-and-research-center-in-jeddah-saudi-arabia/)

*   Swimming Pool – heated in some of the housing units

*   Personalized Training Program for athletics
*   Fitness and wellness programs
*   Organized trips through the Employee Social Club.

*   Contracts start with a two (2) years period and renewable thereafter annually by both party agreement (You can ask for a one-year contract, if it’s your preference)

## **King Abdulaziz Medical City**

## National Guard Health Affairs - Jeddah

## General Information

**King Abdulaziz Medical City (KAMC) are in Riyadh, Jeddah, Al-Hassa, Dammam & Madinah. These hospitals deliver high quality primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary health care services to Saudi Arabian National Guard (SANG) personnel, civilian employees & their dependents. It facilitates offer an excellent learning environment and continuous professional development opportunities. SANG hospitals employ approximately 40% Western qualified medical staff and are operated to Western standards.**  
  
  
**The facility in Jeddah, which has a 751-bed capacity, 10 Departments & 2 Specialized Services, provides state-of-the-art practice medical care services for the Saudi Arabian population in the Western Region. In addition to that, it promotes and advances understanding of diseases prevention amongst the people. It also initiates, interacts, and indulges in the medical base practice in the institutional, local, regional, national, and international collegial communities.**

## Hospital Location

 KAMC is in downtown Jeddah, a city of approximately 4 million, situated along the Red Sea, only a few minutes away from the King Abdulaziz International airport. 

## Departments & Services

**Departments**

*   Anesthesia
*   Bed Management
*   Dental Services
*   Emergency Medicine
*   Infection Prevention & Control
*   Intensive Care
*   Medical Imaging
*   Medicine
*   Obstetrics & Gynecology
*   Surgery

**Specialized/Ancillary Services**

*   Pathology & Laboratory Medicine
*   Medical Eligibility

**Centers**

*   Princess Noorah Oncology Center

All SANG Hospital facilities are JCIA accredited

*   The standard work week at National Guard is 42.5 hours per week.
*   5 Days per week / The number of hours in a shift vary somewhat from department to department but generally do not exceed 10 hours
*   The standard work week in Saudi Arabia is Sunday through Thursday

*   Al Aoun Village is comprised of three bedroom detached and attached villas where mainly accompanied status housing and single male housing is located.

*   All units are fully furnished for the employees’ convenience
*   Utilities such as electricity, water and gas cooking are free and paid-provided by NG for all employees. Cable TV is also provided. Taxi / Limousine services are provided at fixed rates

## **King Abdulaziz Hospital**

## National Guard Health Affairs - Al-Ahsa

## General Information

**The Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques, King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz Al Saud gave directions to build this hospital. It is named after King Abdulaziz, the Arabian Peninsula unifier. Project ‎construction began in 1995 and was completed in May/June 2002.‎**

**The campus has four parts: the hospital and its annexed buildings, families and nurses housing, ‎singles housing, and public services. The hospital is a 300-beds capacity and is constantly expanding. The Ground Floor includes Outpatient Clinics, Pharmacy, four Operating Rooms, and Day Surgery ‎Operation Room. It also contains beds for Hemodialysis Services, Physical Therapy Department, ‎Radiology Department, Endoscopy, ER, ICU, and Obstetrics & Gynecology Department with L & D ‎rooms, Administration section, and a Mosque.**

**King Abdulaziz National Guard Hospital is dedicated to delivering services of the highest international standard. This constantly expanding facility, equipped with state-of-art technology, is staffed by professionals from Saudi Arabia and 52 other world nations. Saudi Arabian National Guard Hospitals provide ‎primary and secondary care to National Guard personnel, their dependents, and the citizens of the Eastern ‎Region. It consists of 3 levels of 35,000 sq. meters, including Basement, Ground Floor ‎, and First Floor.**

**Employees Health Clinics services, Business clinic Family Medicine and Day Clinics are available to all outpatient children, adults and geriatrics patients of both sexes. Total number of patients attending our clinics in 2020 was 32,387 patients including: walk in, and booked appointments**

## Hospital Location

Al-Hasa, ies in the south of the Kingdom’s Eastern region and bounded by the Al-Dahna and the Al-Daman deserts. The largest oasis in Saudi Arabia, Al-Ahsa is an area that extends from the Arabian Gulf to the Dawha and Oman deserts, and forms the border with Qatar, the United Arab Emirates and the Sultanate of Oman. It is home to more than 600,000 people, who mainly inhabit Al-Ahsa’s four major cities: al-Hofuf, Al-Mobarraz, Al-Oyoun, and Al-Oman. 

## Departments & Services

*   Outpatient’s clinics (OPD)
*   Pharmacy
*   4 Operating Rooms
*   Day Surgery
*   Physical Therapy
*   Radiology
*   Endoscopy
*   ER, ICU, and Ob/Gyn, Labour & Delivery
*   Morgue
*   Academic Affairs
*   Training & Development
*   Laboratory
*   Quality Management
*   Military Field Medicine
*   College of Nursing
*   Dental Laboratory

![Image 7](https://ihrcanada.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/02/160303092134191_img-2-1024x683.jpg)

## Employment Information

**Thinking about working at this hospital? For employment details, check out each topic information below**

[Message to All Candidates](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-abdulaziz-hospital-al-hassa-saudi-arabia/)

All SANG Hospital facilities are JCIA accredited

[Working Hours](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-abdulaziz-hospital-al-hassa-saudi-arabia/)

*   The standard work week at National Guard is 42.5 hours per week.
*   5 Days per week / The number of hours in a shift vary somewhat from department to department but generally do not exceed 10 hours
*   The standard work week in Saudi Arabia is Sunday through Thursday

[Uniforms](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-abdulaziz-hospital-al-hassa-saudi-arabia/)

*   Uniforms are provided on arrival.
*   Uniforms consist of white trousers and tunic top for females, and white trousers and a jacket for males.
*   Duty shoes are not provided and should be purchased by the employee.

[Housing](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-abdulaziz-hospital-al-hassa-saudi-arabia/)

*   Free housing accommodation is provided
*   Medical City: The City covers approximately one square mile set against a background of low desert hills. This first-class accommodation is in apartment blocks of one, two or three bedrooms and is within easy walking distance of the hospital.
*   All hard and soft furnishings are provided free of charge including washing machine, tumble drier, fridge/freezer and all kitchen utensils.
*   Al Aoun Village is comprised of three bedroom detached and attached villas where mainly accompanied status housing and single male housing is located.
*   In addition to the villas there are three- and one-bedroom bungalows. You will have complete comfort and privacy like your own home
*   All units are fully furnished for the employees’ convenience
*   Utilities such as electricity, water and gas cooking are free and paid-provided by NG for all employees. Cable TV is also provided. Taxi / Limousine services are provided at fixed rates

[Recreational Facilities](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-abdulaziz-hospital-al-hassa-saudi-arabia/)

*   Employee accommodations are adjacent to the hospital and are equipped with excellent recreational facilities, including an Olympic-sized swimming pool, tennis courts, gymnasium, and weight rooms.The compound is fully secured with 24 hours security by the military personnel*
*   Restaurants, Cafes, supermarkets, shopping malls libraries, hairdressing salons & services are all readily accessible*
*   There are a wide range of restaurants in the cities; serving traditional Lebanese, Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, etc (including popular Western fare eg McDonalds and Starbucks)*
*   Organized camping trips to local scenic areas and places of interest take place at regular intervals and it is possible to join others from the hospital on short trips to neighbouring countries such as Egypt, Yemen and Jordan*
*   For children of eligible staff there is child care for pre-school infants as well as a primary school providing a British based education system*
*   There are a wide range of activities available for the athletic, adventurous or nature lover

[Benefits](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/king-abdulaziz-hospital-al-hassa-saudi-arabia/)

*   Contracts start with a one (1) year period and renewable thereafter annually by both party agreement
*   Tax Free Income
*   Forty-Five (45) calendar days per service year paid vacation
*   Medical Insurance coverage for all self and family (when offered Married Status Contract)
*   Mobilization ticket for self and family (when offered Married Status Contract). Economy class tickets
*   Ticket to return to point of hire at the end of your contract – Economy class
*   Annual ticket to point of hire (can use to other destinations) for self and family (when offered Married Status Contract), Economy Class
*   Suitable housing provided, depending on position, married status, availability and etc, or housing allowance in lieu.
*   Transportation to hospital site when living at hospital’s provided accommodation, or transportation allowance in lieu when living out of hospital’s accommodation.
*   One month pay bonus when renewing contract.
*   End of service indemnity (as per country labor laws). Two weeks pay for each year completed in first 5 years of service with this hospital, then one month pay for each year served. To be collected when agreement terminated with the hospital
*   Continues Medical Education for **Physicians**. Seven (7) Days every year to attend events (not taken out of vacation time) in addition to payment certain

## **King Salman Specialized Hospital**

## National Guard Health Affairs - Taif

## General Information

King Salman Specialized Hospital stands at the forefront of cutting-edge healthcare in Taif, seamlessly integrating state-of-the-art technology with compassionate patient care. Comprising three main parts – The Inpatient, The Diagnostic and Treatment (D and T) Podium, and The Clinics Building – this modern medical complex caters to both inpatient and outpatient needs with exceptional expertise.

Situated next to the new MNGHA Saudi Arabian National Guard housing (SANG) development, the hospital’s location ensures easy access for patients and healthcare professionals alike.

As a LEED (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certified building, King Salman Specialized Hospital prioritizes sustainability, meeting international standards for eco-friendly design.

With a capacity for 300 beds, this newly established hospital underscores the government’s dedication to improving healthcare facilities across the region, promising top-tier standards and outstanding care for every patient.

## Hospital Location

KSSH is located in Taif City in the western side of Saudi Arabia with an estimated population of 688,693 people, making it the 6th most populous city in the kingdom. It is considered the summer capital of Saudi Arabia and enjoys a moderate weather on higher slopes with an elevation of 1,879 m (6,165 ft). The city is connected to the nearby resort town of Al-Hada via the iconic Highway 15 (Taif – Al-Hada Road). Taif City pplays an active role in the agricultural output of Saudi Arabia where cultivation of grapes, pomegranate, figs, roses and honey are grown and harvested. It is known as “City of the Roses” as it actively manufactures the traditional Rose Attar aka Rose water.

## **Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Hospital**

## National Guard Health Affairs - Madinah

## General Information

**PMBAH is the fifth Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs (MNGHA) facility in the Kingdom after Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and Al Ahsa. It is a fully serviced facility with a 215-bed capacity. The Hospital will provide primary and secondary care to National Guard personnel.**

**The MNGHA gives high regard to the welfare of its workforce. For example, orientation and induction are given to new staff to ensure they are competent, confident, and supported through mentorship and preceptorship to mold them into the workforce. Furthermore, benefits and rewards are very encouraging to the staff.**

## Hospital Location

 Madinah is the second holy city to Muslims after Makkah. It has also got many other names such as Taibah, Yathrib, the City of the Messenger, and Dar Al-Higra (i.e. Home of Immigration). It is the city whose people supported Prophet Mohammad (peace be upon him) when he immigrated from Makkah. It comprises the Mosque of the Prophet, his grave, the Islamic University, King Fahd Complex for the Printing of the Holy Quran and many archaeological Islamic features. Madinah is a city in the Hejaz region of western Saudi Arabia, and serves as the capital of the Al Madinah Province.   
  
 Located at the foot of Mount Uhud on Prince Naif Road. PMBAH is only minutes away from Prince Mohammad Bin Abdulaziz Airport and the Holy Mosque – Al Masjid Al Nabawi.

[Uniforms](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Uniforms are provided on arrival.
*   Uniforms consist of white trousers and tunic top for females, and white trousers and a jacket for males.
*   Duty shoes are not provided and should be purchased by the employee. 

[Housing](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Free housing accommodation is provided
*   Medical City: The City covers approximately one square mile set against a background of low desert hills. This first-class accommodation is in apartment blocks of one, two or three bedrooms and is within easy walking distance of the hospital.
*   All hard and soft furnishings are provided free of charge including washing machine, tumble drier, fridge/freezer and all kitchen utensils.
*   Al Aoun Village is comprised of three bedroom detached and attached villas where mainly accompanied status housing and single male housing is located.
*   In addition to the villas there are three- and one-bedroom bungalows. You will have complete comfort and privacy like your own home
*   All units are fully furnished for the employees’ convenience
*   Utilities such as electricity, water and gas cooking are free and paid-provided by NG for all employees. Cable TV is also provided. Taxi / Limousine services are provided at fixed rates.

[Recreational Facilities](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Employee accommodations are adjacent to the hospital and are equipped with excellent recreational facilities, including an Olympic-sized swimming pool, tennis courts, gymnasium, and weight rooms.The compound is fully secured with 24 hours security by the military personnel*
*   Restaurants, Cafes, supermarkets, shopping malls libraries, hairdressing salons & services are all readily accessible*
*   There are a wide range of restaurants in the cities; serving traditional Lebanese, Indian, Chinese, Japanese, Italian, etc (including popular Western fare eg McDonalds and Starbucks)*
*   Organized camping trips to local scenic areas and places of interest take place at regular intervals and it is possible to join others from the hospital on short trips to neighbouring countries such as Egypt, Yemen and Jordan*
*   For children of eligible staff there is child care for pre-school infants as well as a primary school providing a British based education system*
*   There are a wide range of activities available for the athletic, adventurous or nature lover
*   Jeddah probably enjoys the best shopping facilities in The Kingdom. There are numerous well stocked, western style, supermarkets, ultra modern, air conditioned shopping malls and dozens of traditional local markets with an atmosphere all their own. Good buys include gold, watches, carpets and electrical goods
*   Al Aoun Village offers 24 hours security to maintain peaceful and secure surroundings. The facilities offer exemplary services, spacious gardens and beautiful landscaping, swimming pools, modern fitness and recreation center, gymnasium, satellite TV, and a spacious parking area

*Facilities vary per hospital

[Benefits](https://ihrcanada.com/hospitals/prince-mohammad-bin-abdulaziz-hospital-madinah/)

*   Employment contracts are for either one or two years, at the employee’s option, and are very often renewable.
*   Tax Free Income
*   Able to Save the Majority of Your Salary
*   Yearly Service Award (Re-contracting Bonus)
*   Provision of Furnished Housing
*   Yearly Round Trip ticket to Point of Hire
*   Free Medical Coverage
*   Opportunity to Travel (Europe, Fareast and Africa)
*   Single contract /Married contract
*   Some of the positions with a Family Contract (Accompanied Status) up to 3 eligible dependents, one of whom is a spouse
*   Education Allowances for Married contract (2 eligible dependents only, 6-18 years of age)SR23,000 each eligible dependent per school year, subject to submission of school invoices
*   Annual round-trip ticket to Riyadh directly from the location of the school outside the Kingdom Of Saudi Arabia
*   Housing Accommodation
*   Transportation Services
*   Free mobilization and de-mobilization flights to and from point of origin.
*   Baggage allowance
*   30 days of Annual Leave per year ( 2.5 days per month of service, to be utilized by the employee after 6 months of service)
*   Holiday Leave per year ( 5 Days Eid Al Fitr, 5 Days Hajj and 1 Day Saudi National Day)
*   Mid year Benefit (Ticket and 10 days post leave)
*   Entitle for the Overtime Pay (Rate per hour * 150%)
*   Saudi Service Award (Consisting of One-half months basic salary for each of the first five years of service and one month basic salary for each year of services thereafter)
*   Annual vacation air tickets to point of origin (on contract renewal)
*   Uniform & laundry
*   Recreation Services
*   Medical library/ Internet access
*   Telephone access code for personal national and international phone calls (Charges are part of salary deductions)
*   12 month contracts (renewable)
*   Merit increase upon renewal of contract, maximum of 6%
*   Availability of on Job training & courses
*   Availability of Promotion & Transfer

# Spiritual & wellness journey

Combine world-class healthcare with the spiritual fulfilment of visiting the holy sites.

## Healing for body, mind and spirit

At KFSH&RC, we recognise that wellbeing is more than medical care. We support your physical, emotional and spiritual needs throughout your journey.

[Start your journey](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/en/healthcare/international-patients/plan-your-journey)

![Image 12](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/spiritual--wellness-journey/featured-banner/prophet-mosque---desktop.png)![Image 13](https://www.kfshrc.edu.sa/-/media/project/kfshrc/kfshrc/content-authors-imgs/international-patients/spiritual--wellness-journey/featured-banner/prophet-mosque---mobile.png)

## Close to the Prophet’s mosque

Our Madinah location is minutes away from Masjid an-Nabawi, offering convenient access for prayer and pilgrimage during treatment.

[View on map](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QHduHg12iVXiYmze7)

### Support for your spiritual practices

We ensure your spiritual needs are respected and supported throughout your stay.

### Prayer rooms

We provide dedicated facilities, offering quiet, comfortable spaces for patients, families, and visitors.

### Halal meals

We offer patients and their families nutritious, culturally appropriate dining options according to halal standards.

### Fasting support

Our healthcare team is able to adjust treatment schedules, medication timings, and meal plans according to your needs.

### Trained staff

Our diverse, multicultural team respects various religious and cultural practices, providing compassionate, culturally sensitive care.

### Official pilgrimage information

Find everything you need to know when embarking on travel for pilgrimage purposes.

*    Hajj and Umrah  
*    Umrah calendar  
*    Makkah and Madinah  
*    Nusuk  
*    Ministry of Hajj and Umrah
